meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并导出各编码助手的会话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用多个 AI 编码助手，却总想不起上次怎么写的。
copy.tagline_en: Search and export past conversations from coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often lose track of what you did with AI coding tools.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在回答编程代理会话相关问题时，会先运行附带的查找脚本，搜索本地存储的会话记录，再读取具体会话文件核对事实。搜索覆盖 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等多个平台，并输出会话 ID、路径、时间、模型、首尾消息等字段。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、阅读、列出、搜索等处理编程代理会话时触发，例如“我昨天做了什么”“以前是不是做过 X”这类回顾。

say.text: 查一下昨天有 Codex 的会话，关键词是 deploy
say.note: 会运行查找脚本并显示匹配结果。

say.text: 打开上次那个 OpenCode 会话的完整记录
say.note: 会读取该会话的详情与子代理列表。

say.text: 我上周是不是修过这个 bug？帮我查会话记录
say.note: 会扩展为多个查询并搜索包含子代理的记录。

howto.what_en: Claude first runs the bundled search script to locate local coding-agent sessions, then reads the chosen session file for exact evidence. It covers Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and more, returning IDs, paths, times, models, and message previews.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to find, read, list, search, inspect, or export coding-agent sessions, including memory-recall questions like what was done yesterday or whether a task was already done.

say_en.text: Find my Codex sessions from yesterday with keyword deploy.
say_en.note: Runs the finder and shows matching results.

say_en.text: Open the full record of that OpenCode session from last time.
say_en.note: Reads session detail and subagent list.

say_en.text: Did I fix this bug last week? Search session logs.
say_en.note: Expands into multiple queries and includes subagents.
